root_cause_analysis: The Instagram Graph API returned a 403/400-level error (Code 4, Subcode 2207051) indicating an application-level rate limit or security block triggered by the platform's automated integrity systems.
actionable_instructions: Check Meta Business Suite for any account-level restrictions or policy warnings.
Verify if the application has exceeded daily publishing quotas.
Wait at least 60 minutes before attempting a manual retry to allow the rate-limit window to reset.
If the issue persists, review the Instagram Graph API documentation for 'Action is blocked' subcode 2207051 to ensure content compliance.
